title: Robert Goddard rocket testing at Roswell

tellings.quote: I mean, Robert Goddard, who is a rocket pioneer in the US, had just been testing V2 rockets at it right at Roswell.

plain: An American rocket pioneer named Robert Goddard had just been testing rockets right at Roswell, New Mexico, according to Michels, who describes them as V2 rockets, the German wartime missile. He says this himself, without naming a source, as a reason Roswell, the town later famous for a reported 1947 saucer crash, was already a place of secret aerospace work.
